description: Principles of design for manufacturing; modern manufacturing processes and their relative merits and limitations; hands-on experience in metrology, inspection, additive manufacturing and machine shop practice; case study dissections of existing products to explore alternative manufacturing and assembly techniques.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of:
    • MECH200A - Introduction to Technical Drawing and Computer Aided Design (1.5)
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 200B, MECH 200.
title: Introduction to Manufacturing Processes
